turns.question: What was the ratio of non-cancelled order revenue to total ad spend in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ratio metric, so I cannot give the ratio; the closest metrics for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 are Revenue (EUR) at 12,582.75 EUR (non-cancelled orders) and Ad spend (EUR) at 6,270.00 EUR.
